fields.why: A 'progress toward eradication' report that judges AFP surveillance against stated targets (nonpolio AFP rate >1, >80% adequate specimens) is evaluation or monitoring; v5 keeps surveillance/descriptive for reports without goals or targets. The incidence counts belong to the same eradication monitoring, not a separate design.

Crowded urban conditions, poor sanitation and infrastructure are offered for four Indian states (geography, not an SPD), not for a group defined by social position or a disparity, so v5 excludes them as determinants.
